title: oh-my-space oms.yaml
description: Declarative list of independent Git source checkouts for the oms CLI. Each entry names a checkout under oms/<alias>/.

alias.description: Unique identifier; becomes the directory name under oms/. First character must be a lowercase letter or digit; remaining characters may use lowercase letters, digits, -, _, and @.

remotes.description: Named Git remotes; must include "origin". Each value is a clonable Git URL (SSH, HTTPS, or file://). OMS configures additional remotes at clone time.

branch.description: Starting branch for a new clone. Omit to use the remote's default branch.
